text:
mia: Heads-up — planning a 45min livestream + mini-benchmark demo next Tue 9am PT. Goal: 3k signups, 400 active trials, 2k credits used. Experiment idea: give 500 starter credits + a curated onboarding prompt pack, then route top 10% of eng signups to a microcohort for a follow-up office hours. Thoughts?
sam: love the microcohort idea. can we tighten the conversion metric? maybe focus on 'first meaningful response' within 48h rather than overall credits used.
mia: yup good point. primary KPI -> first meaningful response (FMR) within 48h. secondary -> credit consumption.
oliver: for routing: we can tag inbound signups with `source=livestream` and `intent_score` from the signup form. route intent_score >= 8 to microcohort.
jean: quick ask — what’s in the onboarding prompt pack? do we have a short copy deck?
lucy: proposed pack: 5 prompt templates (codegen, summarization, chat assistant, few-shot finetune, reranking), plus a one-page step-by-step. I can draft.
mia: perfect. jean can you own copy and lucy owns prompt pack?
jean: on it. will draft a short landing hero + 3 social posts.
sam: routing flow FYI — recommend this simple config snippet for the signup webhook so we can test in staging:```json
{
  "source":"livestream",
  "credits":500,
  "prompt_pack":"live_starter_v1",
  "route":{"microcohort":true,"min_intent":8}
}```
oliver: deploy-bot: will create a test funnel and a staging webhook.
deploy-bot: created webhook endpoint: https://staging.redwood.ai/webhooks/live-bench-3154321 — ping me when you want test payloads.
mia: thanks. other experiment variables: A/B test subject lines (Live: "Ship with Redwood" vs "Bench: latency, cost, quality"), and two credit amounts (500 vs 1000) to measure marginal lift.
sam: can we keep cohort size small for office hours — 40 folks max. rotating 2 sessions.
lucy: timeline: prompts ready by Fri, copy by Thu, staging webhook test Thu afternoon, email cadence drafted Fri.
jean: also will prepare a 3-slide benchmark narrative to show latency/cost comparisons vs baseline. want to surface: median p95 latency, $/token, and an example prompt quality check.
mia: yes — include a failover narrative: if a model variant regresses, we show fallback plan + rollback metric.
oliver: routing note: we should instrument UTM + signup questions to capture team size and primary use-case. helps prioritize which signups go to microcohort.
sam: for analytics, tag `experiment=live-bench-v1` everywhere. will create GA/event dashboard and share.
mia: ops question — how do we handle credits for enterprise emails (we might leak credits to big customers)?
jean: add a simple rule: if email domain in enterprise allowlist -> mark as sales_lead and no automatic credits, instead flag for AE.
lucy: I'll add a short line in the signup copy: "Starter credits for individual devs — enterprise accounts will be contacted by sales." keeps it honest.
mia: final asks: lucy/jane (jean?) please drop drafts in #marketing-review by Thu EOD. oliver/sam, run staging webhook test Fri AM and post logs. i'll put a calendar invite for the rehearsals.
sam: noted. will post testing checklist.
oliver: test payload example sent to deploy-bot channel.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: rehearsal on Mon 3pm PT.
mia: thanks all — excited to see if the starter prompt pack + credits improves FMR. small next step: pair up and validate the prompt pack with 5 internal devs this week.
jean: volunteers? I’ll recruit from eng slack.
lucy: i’ll run the prompt validation with the onboarding script — tag me.
sam: will track dashboard and share daily spikes.
mia: okay closing thread — keep updates in #marketing and drop final links to assets in this thread before Fri. :rocket:
